Planning Partners.

A research project investigating how educators can use generative AI as a thought partner while keeping instructional goals, context, and professional judgment at the center.

Explore Generative AI in Education →All projects

About the project

Support for planning, not a replacement for judgment.

Planning Partners examines educator-facing AI support for developing and refining instruction.

The work focuses on productive dialogue between educators and AI. Teachers remain responsible for learning goals, classroom context, source selection, and final decisions while the system helps surface possibilities and questions.

A standalone public project site is not yet available. The official Generative AI in Education site below provides the broader UCI program context for this work.
AudienceEducators and instructional designers
FocusAI-supported instructional planning
PrincipleHuman judgment remains in control

Project approach

A collaborative planning process.

Clarify Goals

Planning begins with the learners, objectives, evidence, and constraints that matter in a specific setting.

Explore Alternatives

AI can help educators compare activities, scaffolds, examples, and ways to organize instruction.

Review Critically

Teachers assess suggestions for accuracy, relevance, accessibility, and alignment before using them.
